standards.name: Systems Biology Ontology (SBO)
standards.abstract: The Systems Biology Ontology (SBO) is a structured, controlled set of relational vocabularies used to annotate systems-biology research objects, especially computational models (e.g. SBML models). It defines terms for participant roles (substrate, product), quantitative parameters (Michaelis constant), mathematical expressions (mass action rate law), modeling frameworks (logical, stochastic), entities (macromolecule) and interaction/process types. The standard is developed and maintained by the BioModels.net / SBO project (hosted via the EBI and a GitHub repository) to provide a consistent semantic layer for model annotation, term lookup (OLS), and programmatic access (OWL/OBO exports and APIs).

classification.rationale: The source material is an ontology file (OWL/OBO) and README that expose concrete, repeated data elements for each term (term URI/id, rdfs:label, rdfs:comment/definition, rdfs:subClassOf relationships, and object properties). These are structured metadata fields (not procedural steps or prose instructions), so the standard's structure is best represented as a MetadataTable of ontology term fields.

term_id.name: term_id
term_id.descr: Unique identifier / URI for the ontology class or property (e.g. http://biomodels.net/SBO/SBO_0000000).

definition.name: definition
definition.descr: Textual definition or comment associated with the term (rdfs:comment).
definition.evidence: "<rdfs:comment>Representation of an entity used in a systems biology knowledge reconstruction, such as a model, pathway, network.</rdfs:comment>"

raw_full_info.example: Representation of an entity used in a systems biology knowledge reconstruction, such as a model, pathway, network.

subClassOf.name: subClassOf
subClassOf.descr: Parent/upper-level term relationship (rdfs:subClassOf), expressed as an ontology term reference/URI.

object_property.name: object_property
object_property.descr: Object properties that link classes (OWL object properties), given by URI and a human-readable label.

project_description.name: project_description
project_description.descr: High-level description of the ontology's purpose, scope, and maintainers (from README).
project_description.evidence: "The Systems Biology Ontology is a set of controlled, relational vocabularies of terms commonly used in Systems Biology, and in particular in computational modeling."

term_lookup_and_access.name: term_lookup_and_access
term_lookup_and_access.descr: How terms can be accessed/browsed (e.g., OLS URL and GitHub issue tracker for term requests).
term_lookup_and_access.evidence: "SBO terms can be browsed through the Ontology Lookup Service (OLS) webpage https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols/ontologies/sbo"

standards.notes: The OWL export contains many individual class and property records (each with term_id, label, comment, and relationships). Here the table defines the concrete fields that appear repeatedly across those records; individual SBO terms themselves are instances of these fields inside the OWL file.
